questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Catches (Fielding)' in the 06/07 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Alexis le Breton holds it, with a total of 8, a joint record shared with Liesel Jordaan, Rasika Maharaj and Susan Benade.

questions.question: Which of these unions has Trisha Chetty actually played for?
questions.explanation: Trisha Chetty has represented: Dolphins, Lions, Tuskers.

questions.question: At which ground did Thobeka Thabethe record their career-best bowling figures (4-6, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Union Cricket Ground, against Rhinos on 2022/01/22.

questions.question: At United CC Ground, who holds the record for 'Most Catches' (List A)?
Which of these players was the youngest to debut for the South Africa Open Ladies indoor cricket team?
questions.explanation: Kapp made her debut at 16 years, 9 months, 5 days for South Africa Open Ladies indoor cricket in 2006.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Sixes' in the 13/14 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 7.
